evidence.title: What were Trump operatives doing for pro-Russian politician Dodik in Bosnia?

occurrences.checkable_against: The New York Times report and payment records for James Blair and Chris LaCivita
occurrences.quote_span: According to sources cited by the US newspaper, James Blair and Chris LaCivita advised Dodik and were paid hundreds of thousands of dollars for their work.
occurrences.speaker: sources cited by The New York Times
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by James Blair and Chris LaCivita about the visit
occurrences.quote_span: Blair, who has previously served as Trump’s deputy chief of staff, and LaCivita have not commented on the visit.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Travel records for Blair and LaCivita and the Trump political operation's midterm campaign schedule
occurrences.quote_span: LaCivita were in Republika Srpska at a time when Trump’s political operation was focused on the final stretch of its campaign for midterm congressional elections in the US.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Dodik campaign and election communications documenting results of Blair and LaCivita's advice
occurrences.quote_span: Aleksandar Trifunovic, editor of Buka magazine in Banja Luka, said he could see no concrete result from their work advising Dodik.

occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Republika Srpska lobbying activity and public filings
occurrences.quote_span: Ivana Korajlic of Transparency International told Al Jazeera that Republika Srpska would likely not stop lobbying, “it will only be presented in a different way”.
occurrences.speaker: Ivana Korajlic
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Milorad Dodik's election-night speech or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: “If it had not been for Trump’s magnificent victory, we would probably be political corpses today. But thanks to the new environment, we are now political winners,” Dodik said.
occurrences.speaker: Milorad Dodik
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.checkable_against: Dodik speeches and campaign messaging before and after the advisers' engagement
occurrences.quote_span: “We don’t see anything that would allow us to say: ‘This is what they taught him, and that is why he won the election.’ Dodik’s rhetoric has not changed. It has been similar to MAGA rhetoric for a long time. But it was important for Dodik to be able to say that he had Trump’s people working for him. So what Dodik paid for and what he got was proximity to Trump through Trump’s people,” Trifunovic told Al Jazeera.
occurrences.speaker: Aleksandar Trifunovic
occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita

occurrences.quote_span: LaCivita previously worked as a political campaign strategist for Sali Berisha, one of the most influential Albanian politicians of the post-socialist period, in the run up to Albanian elections last year.

occurrences.subject: James Blair and Chris LaCivita
